                raise TransportError("network")
            return await super().post(url, json=json, accept_encoding=accept_encoding)

    created = []

    def transport_factory(loaded):
        transport = RotatingTransport(loaded)
        created.append(transport)
        return transport

def test_confirm_is_one_shot_and_holds_the_write_lock_for_all_three_posts():
    class PausingTransport(MutationTransport):
        def __init__(self, state, responses):
            super().__init__(state, responses)
            self.after_summary_next = asyncio.Event()
            self.release_summary_next = asyncio.Event()

        async def post(self, url, *, json, accept_encoding, headers=None):
            response = await super().post(
                url,
                json=json,
                accept_encoding=accept_encoding,
                headers=headers,
            )
            if len(self.calls) == 3:
                self.after_summary_next.set()
                await self.release_summary_next.wait()
            return response

    async def scenario():
        state = bundle()
        responses = [
            start_response(),
            workflow_response("SUCCESS", flow="me2meCreate", state="summary"),
            workflow_response("EXTERNAL_ENTER", url=CONFIRMATION_WORKFLOW_PATH),
            workflow_response("EXTERNAL_RETURN", url=ME2ME_WORKFLOW_PATH),
            workflow_response(
                "SUCCESS",
                flow="me2meInfo",
                state="showInfo",
                output={
                    "document": {"srcDocumentId": "fixture-document"},
                    "screens": [{"header": [{"properties": {"level": "done"}}]}],
                },
            ),
            {"success": True},
        ]
        transport = PausingTransport(state, responses)
        client = AsyncSberClient(state, transport=transport)
        draft = await client.transfers.start()
        prepared = await client.transfers.prepare(
            draft,
            source_id=SOURCE,
            destination_id=DESTINATION,
            amount=Decimal("1"),
        )

        confirmed = asyncio.create_task(client.transfers.confirm(prepared))
        await transport.after_summary_next.wait()
        rename_started = asyncio.Event()

        async def rename():
            rename_started.set()
            await client.cards.rename(1, "Valid")

        renamed = asyncio.create_task(rename())
        await rename_started.wait()
        assert not renamed.done()
        transport.release_summary_next.set()
        result, _ = await asyncio.gather(confirmed, renamed)

        assert result.document_id == "fixture-document"
        assert urlsplit(transport.calls[-1][0]).path == CHANGE_PRODUCT_NAME_PATH
        assert all(
            urlsplit(call[0]).path != CHANGE_PRODUCT_NAME_PATH
            for call in transport.calls[:5]

        before = len(transport.calls)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="уже передавался"):
